detail: Alt Material Innovations Private Limited, dba altM, has raised $10.3 million from a Series A fundraise led by Rainmatter by Zerodha and Mela Ventures, with participation from existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact, along with VC Grid and other strategic angel investors. Argus Partners advised altM on this fundraise.
